examples.text: Beim Apfelkuchen liegt das Obst nicht obendrauf, sondern versinkt im fluffigen Kuchenboden, der Schoko-Mandarine-Kuchen ist enorm cremig und beim Zitronenkuchen merkt man sofort, dass die Zitrusfrucht selbst gerieben wurde, ohne dass sie sich aber zu penetrant nach vorn drängen würde.
examples.translation: Dans la tarte aux pommes, les fruits ne se trouvent pas sur le dessus, mais s’enfoncent dans le fond de tarte moelleux, la tarte au chocolat et à la mandarine est extrêmement crémeuse et dans la tarte au citron, on remarque tout de suite que c'étaient bien des agrumes que l’on a râpés, sans toutefois qu'ils s’imposent de manière trop envahissante.

glosses: sich leicht, locker oder weich anfühlend, verhaltend oder schmeckend

examples.text: Der Hund meines Freundes fühlt sich so schön fluffig an.
Der perfekte Kaiserschmarren muss fluffig sein.
Das ist ein echt fluffiger Song.

translations.source_sense_description: sich leicht, locker oder weich anfühlend, verhaltend oder schmeckend

examples.text: Fluffy bunny rabbits are really nice to stroke.
I like my scrambled eggs to be light and fluffy in texture.
Being in love with my boyfriend gives me a fluffy feeling inside.

glosses: Not clearly defined or explained; fuzzy.

examples.text: Someone sold you the fluffy idea that brains triumphs^([sic]) over strength when you were picked last for the sports team.

glosses: Lightweight; superficial; lacking depth or seriousness.

examples.text: And she is represented reading with great concentration, and not some fluffy novel but the rather politically oriented and literary Le Figaro, its title prominent if upside down in the foreground.

There was, I think, always a fluffy element to the neo-Pagan movement, but since the Internet explosion of the mid-to-late 1990s, it's got much, much worse. Most of it can be blamed on commercial drivers, as the publishers who produced neo-Pagan material (and the authors who work for them) realised that there was a vast market for teen-witch kits, bogus grimoires, etc, and set out to exploit it […]

glosses: Someone or something that has a fluffy texture.

examples.text: Children can pamper the fluffies in the pets' corner […]

glosses: A person who is superficial, who lacks depth or seriousness.

examples.text: The world is overrun with fluffies.
